children: Catcher Predict monitoring showed that the Polymarket submarket "80,000" in the "Bitcoin breaks through on September 6" event saw its "Yes" odds swing sharply. title: Polymarket Bitcoin September 6 Breakout Bet Sees Sharp Drop in 80,000 Yes Odds
